title: Who you know
searchPlaceholder: Search by name, alias, or handle…
emptySelf: No self profile yet. Name yourself so Isoform knows who you are and doesn't mistake your own messages for someone else's.
emptyContacts: Add people you chat with regularly so their messages aren't mistaken for yours.
emptyStateDesc: More people appear as you work with them.
deleteDescription: This removes the person and all of their app handle bindings. Memory and activity records that already reference them keep their existing labels.
selfNotSeenYet: Isoform hasn't seen any chat messages attributed to you yet. Once you chat in WeChat, Slack, etc., your own messages will start showing up here.
contactNotSeenYet: Isoform hasn't seen messages from this person in any chat yet. Make sure their handle bindings cover the apps they use.
pickerNoResults: No people match. Try adding a contact.
mergeDescription: Pick the person this entry should be folded into. All chat handles, aliases, sightings and recent messages move over, and this entry is hidden. You can undo the merge.
mergePreview: "{{src}}" will be hidden; everything moves into "{{dst}}". You can undo this.
cleanupStep1Body: entries from non-chat apps (Mail.app newsletters, Sentry alerts, GitHub bots, etc.) get deleted. They're not people.
cleanupStep2Body: trailing "12:25" timestamps, "OP Original Poster" role badges, and message body bleed get stripped from surviving names.
cleanupStep3Body: entries that collapse to the same cleaned name are merged (oldest wins; sightings, recent messages, and session links move over).
cleanupFootnote: Your Self profile and any named Contacts are left untouched.
cleanupSuccessToast: Scanned {{scanned}} — pruned {{pruned}} non-chat, renamed {{renamed}}, merged {{merged}} same-app, merged {{crossApp}} cross-app same-name, folded {{intoNamed}} into named.
cleanupNoOpToast: Nothing to clean up — all unidentified senders are already tidy.
activitySessionsEmpty: No captured Activity session references this person yet. Entries created before session tracking was added (PR #1809, commit 4) won't backfill — only newly captured chats will start populating this list.
voicePrintRecordButtonTitle: Record a {{seconds}}-second voice sample to enroll your fingerprint
voicePrintEnrolledHint: Isoform will now verify mic transcripts against your voice. Speech that doesn't match is treated as someone else's — not stored as your statements or preferences.
voicePrintEmptyHint: Record a short sample so Isoform can tell your voice apart from others using the same mic (coworkers, family members). Without this, in-person conversations may be mis-attributed to you.
voicePrintTestButtonTitle: Record a {{seconds}}-second sample and check if it matches your enrolled voice
voicePrintTestHintMatch: Your fresh sample scored above the threshold, so background-listening transcripts from your mic will be attributed to you. If you re-test and it dips below 0.62, re-enroll a sample in your current environment.
voicePrintTestHintNoMatch: Your fresh sample scored below the threshold — verification would treat this voice as someone else's. Likely causes: different mic, very different acoustic environment, or a head cold. Try re-enrolling a sample in this environment.
voicePrintTestNoEnrollment: Record at least one voice sample first.
dossierResearchingHint: Building a quick profile from what Isoform knows — about 15 seconds.
dossierEmpty: No dossier yet. Research this person to enrich the contact with a web-sourced profile.
contactsImportButtonTitle: Choose people you already know from Contacts or a vCard file
contactsImportDescription: Choose contacts from this computer, or import a vCard file.
contactsImportAccessFailed: Could not check Contacts access. Try again.
contactsImportConsentWhy: So Isoform can recognize the people you already know in meetings and messages.
contactsImportConsentWhat: Isoform reads all contact names, photos, phone numbers and email addresses from this computer. After you allow access, it saves them quietly and checks for changes when the app starts and every six hours.
contactsImportConsentWhere: Contacts are saved on this computer and help recognize people in your computer and phone experience. Their details may be included in context sent to your chosen assistant.
contactsImportConsentNever: Imported people are never researched automatically.
contactsImportConsentAccept: I agree to let Isoform save and keep my contacts in sync.
contactsFileConsentAccept: I agree to let Isoform import contacts from this file.
contactsImportConsentFailed: Could not save your consent. No contacts were read. Try again.
contactsImportConsentSummary: All contacts are saved and kept in sync on this computer. Their details may be shared with your chosen assistant and used in your phone experience. Imported people are never researched automatically.
contactsImportPermissionGrantHint: macOS asks once. You can change this later in System Settings.
contactsImportSettingsFailed: Could not open System Settings. Open Privacy & Security, Contacts manually, then try again.
contactsImportPermissionDenied: Isoform cannot read Contacts. Turn on Isoform under System Settings, Privacy & Security, Contacts, then choose Try again here.
contactsImportPermissionRestricted: Contacts access is restricted on this computer, so Isoform cannot read them. You can still import a vCard file.
contactsImportLoadFailed: Could not read your contacts. Try again.
contactsImportResult: Imported {{imported}}, merged {{merged}} with people you already have, and skipped {{skipped}}.
contactsImportErrors: Some contact details could not be saved.
contactsImportFailed: Could not import these contacts. Try again.
contactsImportVCardHint: Choose a .vcf file exported from your address book.
contactsImportVCardFailed: Could not read that vCard file. Try again.
contactsImportUnavailable: Contacts sync is not available on this computer.
contactsImportRemoveDescription: Isoform removes the {{count}} people created by address-book imports. Existing people you matched and contacts imported from vCard files are kept. This computer’s address book is not changed.
contactsImportRemoveFailed: Could not remove the imported contacts. Try again.
contactsSyncFailed: Could not update Contacts. Please try again.
contactsSyncRemoveDescription: Imported contacts and their linked details will be removed. Existing people and their original handles will stay. Automatic syncing will pause until you connect Contacts again.
contactsSyncConsent: Connect Contacts to recognize people you know.
contactsSyncNeedsAccess: Contacts needs access on this computer
contactsSyncError: Contacts could not sync. Check access and try again.
contactLinkDescription: Search contacts imported from this computer. Linking brings their details to this person on your computer and phone. You can unlink later.
contactLinkSearch: Search by name, phone or email
contactLinkEmpty: No matching contacts. Connect Contacts to sync the contacts on this computer.
contactLinkFailed: Could not load or link this contact. Please try again.
contactUnlinkFailed: Could not unlink this contact. Please try again.
contactsFileConsentWhat: Isoform reads the names, phone numbers and email addresses in a contact file you choose. Contacts from a file are saved on this computer; file imports do not refresh automatically.
contactsFileConsentSummary: Contacts from a file are saved on this computer. Their details may be shared with your chosen assistant and used in your phone experience. Imported people are never researched automatically.
